title: Antirion configuration document, version 1
description: The complete Antirion config document: every top-level key and every field. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere except declared free-form maps. `x-range` gives a duration or size field's inclusive bounds (`min`, `max`) and exclusive lower bound (`gt`); see schema/README.md. Cross-field and cross-reference rules are semantic validation and are not all expressed here.

allOf.description: auth.mode: disabled with any secret key or JWT provider is rejected.

Duration.description: Duration: digits with an optional fraction and a unit ms|s|m|h|d; no negatives; `d` = 24 h. Bounds of each field are in `x-range`.

DurationOrNone.description: A duration, or the string "none" where the owning spec allows it.

Size.description: Size with an IEC unit: B, KiB, MiB, GiB; integers only.

Money.description: Money: a decimal string in USD, never a number.

Decimal.description: A non-negative decimal string (weights, multipliers and `bytes_per_token`).

Secret.description: A secret: a reference `${env:NAME}`, `${file:/abs/path}` or `${<store>:<ref>}`, or a literal. Literals are stored encrypted and read back as "[REDACTED]".

Url.description: Operator URL: http(s), no userinfo, an ASCII LDH host or a canonical IP literal, port 1–65535, never a cloud-metadata name or an always-denied IP literal.

HttpsUrl.description: Operator URL: http(s), no userinfo, an ASCII LDH host or a canonical IP literal, port 1–65535, never a cloud-metadata name or an always-denied IP literal. https unless 's egress policy allows plain http for the host.

BaseUrl.description: Provider base URL: an operator URL without fragment and without `.` or `..` path segments; `{region}` and `{location}` may appear in the host.

HeaderValue.description: A header value: no control characters other than tab; may be a secret reference.

ForwardableHeaderName.description: A header name that is not on 's always-deny list.

NonCredentialHeaderName.description: A header name that is not a credential header.

Base64Key32.description: A secret reference, or a literal: base64 of exactly 32 bytes.

HeaderValues.description: Map header name → value; values may be secret references.

FieldPath.description: A field path relative to a policies member, e.g. `retry.max_attempts`.

Cidr.description: An IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR with host bits zero.

ModelName.description: Public Model name: 1–128 of [A-Za-z0-9._:/-], starting with a letter or digit; a wildcard Model may also contain `*`, including first.

AliasName.description: Model alias: as a Model name, without `*`.

McpName.description: MCP server or A2A agent name.

LimitName.description: Limit or budget declaration name. `locked` and `request_overridable` are reserved.

NotReservedName.description: `locked` and `request_overridable` are reserved inside every `policies` member: no named entry may use them (detail code `reserved_name`).

Tag.description: A tag (grammar); the `antirion.` prefix is reserved.

TagPattern.description: A tag pattern with at most one `*`.

NamePattern.description: A name pattern: an exact name, one `*` at the start or the end, or `*` alone.

ModelPattern.description: Model pattern: exact name, one `*` at the start or the end, `*`, `provider/*`, `provider/name`, or `group:<name>`.

ClientTls.description: Client TLS block, used at providers.<name>.tls and observability.traces.exporter.tls.

verify.description: false only for operator destinations; logged and reported.

n_fan_out.description: A non-streaming Chat Completions request with n > 1 to a deployment without native n is served by n parallel upstream calls.

max.description: The largest n emulated; a larger n keeps the capability rule.

completions_to_chat.description: A /v1/completions request whose Model has no deployment serving Completions is served as a Chat Completions request.

endpoints.description: Map endpoint id → settings. `default_model` does not exist.

responses_websocket.description: Responses events over a WebSocket on GET /v1/responses; default true, and only while `responses` is enabled.

items.description: Pointer into the upstream body; `/model`, `/stream` and the `-` token are rejected.

propertyNames.description: Pointer into the upstream body; `/model`, `/stream` and the `-` token are rejected.
Pointer into the upstream body; `/model`, `/stream` and the `-` token are rejected.

assistant_prefill.description: A final assistant turn is continued.

max_stop_sequences.description: Largest number of stop sequences accepted; 4 when unknown.

sts_endpoint.description: Optional STS endpoint URL; default: the regional AWS STS endpoint.

service_account_json.description: Secret reference or literal JSON; absent = ADC.

Provider.description: A provider. Type-specific blocks must match `type`.

headers.description: Extra upstream headers; credential, framing, hop-by-hop and always-deny names are rejected.

operations.description: Per-operation path override; starts with `/` and not `//`.

azure.description: api_version required iff api_style = deployments, and rejected otherwise.

anthropic.description: Anthropic settings: on `anthropic`, and on `bedrock` / `vertex` for their Anthropic models. `version` is not sent on Bedrock and Vertex, whose body carries `anthropic_version`.

base_url.description: A base path ending in /openai or /openai/v1 is rejected (step 6).

allOf.description: vertex needs gcp.project, except with auth.method api_key (express mode).

Weights.description: Pricing class → weight, a decimal ≥ 0; omitted classes = 1.

Match.description: All present fields must match; each list is OR.

per.description: Required unless unit=concurrency, forbidden for it.

overrides.description: Per partition value; requires exactly one partition attribute.

priority_shares.description: Priority class (a key's `priority_class`) → its share of the limit, a ratio; the shares add up to at most 1, and classes without a share count together in the remainder.

priority_mode.description: Only with `priority_shares`: `strict` keeps each class within its share; `borrow` lets a class use the rest of the limit except what the other classes have not used of their shares.

amount.description: usd: decimal string ≥ 0 with ≤ 9 decimals; tokens: integer ≥ 0.

algorithm.description: A rolling budget over a duration `period`. Absent: the period's own windows (calendar, lifetime or fixed duration).

precision.description: Sliding_window only: sub-windows per period; each sub-window is at least 1 s and a whole number of microseconds. Default: hourly sub-windows (period / 1h, at least 1), which depends on `period`, so no `default` keyword.

cache_hits_bypass_budgets.description: Defer this budget's refusal until after cache_lookup, so a cache hit is served without consulting it.

Price.description: A price: token rates in USD per 1M tokens, unit prices in USD, optional tiers.

service_tiers.description: Service tier name → multiplier of the token rates, applied when the upstream response (else the request) names that tier.

batch_multiplier.description: Multiplier of the token rates for usage settled from a Batches API job (for example "0.5"). Absent: 1.

CallPrice.description: Price of an MCP tool or A2A agent call.

model.description: Upstream model id (Azure: deployment name; Bedrock: model id, profile id or ARN).

region.description:
The deployment's region (any provider type): the region allow-lists of match it; for bedrock also the signing and endpoint region, overriding providers.

.aws.region.

dialects.description: Dialects that receive comment heartbeats; `gemini` and `bedrock` are rejected.

stream_upstream.description: Non-streaming client requests are sent to the upstream as streams and aggregated into one complete response.

Predicate.description: Predicate: all, any, not, or field plus exactly one operator; keys AND together.

sample.description: Deterministic fraction of requests, by request id.

min_samples_per_arm.description: Bandit nursery: feedback samples each arm takes in turn before Thompson sampling.

metric.description: Algorithm thompson only: the feedback metric whose values are the rewards; a boolean metric, or a number metric with min and max.

arms.description: Algorithm thompson only: the arms (child ids) the bandit chooses among. Absent: every child with a weight above 0.

stop_after.description: Algorithm thompson only: once an arm's posterior probability of being the best exceeds 1 − delta, every later request goes to it.

scorer.description: Scorer. `external`: `url` and `headers`; `llm`: `model` and `max_tokens`; `classifier`: `match` and `classes`; `matrix_factorization`: `model_file`, `embedding_model` and `models`; `random` takes no other field.

model_file.description: matrix_factorization: the pre-trained model file (JSON: `models`, `projection`, `classifier`), read when the configuration is applied.

embedding_model.description: matrix_factorization: the embeddings Model that embeds the routing text.

models.description: matrix_factorization: the scoring pair, by their names in the model file.

picker_service.description: The endpoint picker of `picker: external`: a gRPC service speaking the external-processing protocol, over HTTP/2 (cleartext for an http URL).

NodeObject.description: A route-tree node object, dispatched on `type`; `type` is inferred as `deployment` when `deployment` is set, `route` when `route` is set, and is required otherwise.

WeightedChild.description: A child of a `weighted` or `least_busy` node: a node object that may carry `weight`, or a bare deployment name.

Node.description: A node, or a bare deployment name as shorthand for {type: deployment, deployment: <name>}. `weight` is allowed only on children of `weighted` and `least_busy`.

access.description: Who may use a preview or restricted Model.

default_models.description: Endpoint → Model used when a request has none.

tiers.description: Custom tiers. Built-in tiers need no declaration.

propertyNames.description: A built-in tier (frontier, balanced, fast, specialized) or one declared in routing.tiers.

classes.description: Per-class overrides; fixed classes accept none.

retry_on_response.description: Predicates over a 2xx answer; one that matches makes the attempt a `server_error` whose only action is the next deployment, never counted toward health. `header`/`equals` is read from the response head; `finish_reason` and `empty_content` need the whole answer, so they apply to complete (non-streaming) responses.

Resilience.description: Top-level `resilience`: gateway-wide health, classification and exposure; never inside policies.

health_overrides.description: Deployment → any subset of `health` except active_checks.request.

status_overrides.description: "NNN" → class; never 2xx; 400/404/413/422 only to caller_error, context_length or content_policy.

retry_budget.description: Retries onto a deployment are capped per node at max(10 s × min_per_second, ratio × first attempts) over a sliding 10 s window.

logo.description: An https URL, or a data: URI of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image ≤ 64 KiB.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the console's default display.

secret.description: Config-declared keys only; not with kind jwt.

require_client_cert.description: The key authenticates only on a request whose verified client certificate matches; exactly one of the two members.

priority_class.description: The class this key's requests count in for limits with `priority_shares`. Absent: no class (the remainder).

forwarded_client_cert.description: A request from a peer in security.client_ip.trusted_proxies may carry the client certificate its proxy verified in Client-Cert (RFC 9440).

additionalProperties.description: Model patterns; `group:` is not allowed here (no nesting).

allow_insecure_jwks.description: Fetch `jwks_uri` over plain http or an unverified TLS profile outside test mode.

allOf.description: Some key material: jwks_uri, jwks or hmac_secret.

allow_insecure_discovery.description: Fetch discovery, the JWKS and the token endpoint over plain http or an unverified TLS profile outside test mode.

idp.description: Exactly one source of the identity provider: metadata_url, metadata, or entity_id with sso_url and certificates.

metadata_url.description: The identity provider's metadata, fetched as operator egress and kept in the store.

metadata.description: The identity provider's metadata document, inline.

certificates.description: PEM signing certificates; an assertion signed by any of them is trusted.

allow_insecure_metadata.description: With metadata_url: fetch the metadata over plain http, or with an egress TLS profile that does not verify servers, outside test mode.

sp_entity_id.description: Null = <origin>/admin/v1/auth/saml/<name>/metadata, the origin being auth.admin.public_origin or the request's own.

email_attribute.description: The attribute holding the user's email address; null = the NameID.

attribute.description: A SAML attribute's Name, as the assertion carries it.

allow_idp_initiated.description: Accept responses the identity provider sends without a request.

oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 sign-in without an ID token.

roles.description: Custom roles: a name that is not a built-in role; bindable_at defaults to organization, team and project.

device_authorization.description: The CLI sign-in through the device authorization grant.

code_ttl.description: How long a device code and its user code stay valid.

poll_interval.description: The least time between two polls of one device code.

token_ttl.description: The lifetime of the admin token a sign-in issues.

max_starts_per_minute.description: Device authorizations one client address may start per minute.

ip_sets.description: Named IP sets referenced as `set:<name>` in allowed_ips.

LimitsSettings.description: Top-level `limits`: settings only; declarations live in policies.limits.

PolicyLimits.description: `policies.limits`: map name → limit declaration, plus 's `locked` / `request_overridable`, which are reserved names.

PolicyBudgets.description: `policies.budgets`: map name → budget declaration, plus 's `locked` / `request_overridable`, which are reserved names.

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression in UTC (schedule triggers).

endpoints.description: Subset of; the native generate endpoints use 's ids.

ignore_fields.description: JSON Pointer patterns (`*` as a whole token); not under /model.

per_item.description: Each element of an `openai.embeddings` request's `input` array is cached on its own; only the elements that miss go upstream.

divert_to.description: The Model whose route serves a request with a finding; required with action divert and only with it.

reversible.description: Input values become numbered tokens ([EMAIL_1]) that the output stage puts back; needs action redact, replacement label and no preserve.

user_prefix.description: Added before the first text of the last user message.

user_suffix.description: Added after the last text of the last user message.

llm_judge.description: `llm_judge` settings: the Model asked and the operator prompt, whose `{{content}}` receives the inspected text.

schema.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 the content must satisfy; required unless use_request_schema.

use_request_schema.description: Validate against the request's own response schema when it has one.

reask.description: How many times a non-streaming or buffered response that fails is asked for again.

length.description: `length` settings: bounds on characters, words or estimated tokens.

classifier.description: `classifier` settings: a text-classification endpoint answering `[{label, score}]` per input; the guardrail's `categories` maps labels to categories.

thresholds.description: Label → the score at or above which it is a finding.

bedrock_guardrails.description: `bedrock_guardrails` settings: Bedrock ApplyGuardrail, signed with a `bedrock` provider's AWS credentials.

azure_content_safety.description: `azure_content_safety` settings: Azure AI Content Safety text analysis.

model_armor.description: `model_armor` settings: Model Armor sanitize calls, authorised with a `vertex` provider's GCP credentials.

template.description: `template` settings (-072, -073): named message templates with {{variable}} placeholders, rendered from the request's `template` object.

content.description: Text with {{name}} placeholders (a letter or `_`, then letters, digits or `_`; spaces inside the braces allowed).

required.description: : requests it applies to must carry a `template` object.

llm_rewrite.description: `llm_rewrite` settings: the Model asked and the operator prompt (its system message); the in-scope segments are sent as {"segments": [{"id", "text"}]}.

topic.description: `topic` settings: an embeddings Model and topic descriptions; at least one of allowed and denied is non-empty.

Guardrails.description: Top-level `guardrails` singleton: settings plus `definitions`, the map served as the `/guardrails` collection. `replacement: hash` requires `hash_key`.

additionalProperties.description: OtlpLogSink: each record exported as one OTLP LogRecord whose body is the record's JSON and whose trace and span ids are the record's.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the collector; egress subject to HTTP protocols post to <endpoint>/v1/logs, gRPC calls the LogsService at the endpoint.

additionalProperties.description: LangfuseSink: a trace-ingestion exporter; one trace per record and one generation per attempt, posted to <url>/api/public/ingestion with basic authentication.

url.description: Base URL of the ingestion service; egress subject to

header_attributes.description: Request header → span attribute; credential headers are rejected.

viewer_url.description: Link template of an external trace viewer: `{trace_id}` (and optionally `{span_id}`) is replaced by the record's ids; reported by `GET /admin/v1/status` as `trace_viewer_url` for the console's request detail.

silence_during_maintenance.description: Instances that fire while a maintenance window is current are created snoozed until its end, and refires inside one notify no one.

forward.description: ; entries on the always-deny list are errors.

enabled.description: : false keeps it validated and referenceable, and the data plane treats it as absent.

auth.description: Upstream credentials: `oauth_client_credentials` obtains a token for the server, `token_exchange` exchanges the caller's JWT for one (RFC 8693).

client_auth.description: HTTP Basic (RFC 6749 §2.3.1) or `client_id` and `client_secret` in the form.

resource.description: RFC 8707 `resource`; default the server's `url`, null to send none.

pin_tool_definitions.description: Hide a tool whose definition changed until it is approved again (`POST /mcp/servers/{name}:approve_tools`).

admin_server.description: The read-only MCP server at /admin/mcp on the admin listener.

enabled.description: : false keeps it validated and referenceable, and the data plane treats it as absent.

tool_search.description: Tools/list answers only search_tools, get_tool_schema and call_tool.

proxy_registration.description: Relay RFC 7591 dynamic client registration to the first authorization server at `/mcp/<name>/register`.

PolicyMcp.description: `policies.mcp`: MCP grants and the server-side tool loop `mcp_tools`.

when.description: Conditional grants: the level also grants only what its matching rules grant together (a rule without `servers` grants every server); no matching rule grants nothing.

match.description: Conditions over identity attributes; all must hold. A condition on a missing attribute is false.

PolicyMcpModelRoute.description: `policies.mcp` at model and route level: only the tool loop; grants attach gateway → key only.

PolicyA2a.description: `policies.a2a`: A2A grants and the agent-run caps `agent_runs`.

PolicyA2aModelRoute.description: `policies.a2a` at model and route level: only the agent-run caps; grants attach gateway → key only.

wasm.description: `sha256` is required for `file://` and `oci://` modules alike.

config.description: static_response config; extension config stays free-form.

PoliciesTenant.description: `policies` at organization, team, project and key level. Same members as the gateway level.

PoliciesModelRoute.description: `policies` at model and route level. Limits and budgets accumulate as at the model level; `mcp` and `a2a` carry only `mcp_tools` and `agent_runs`, since grants attach gateway → key only.

PoliciesNode.description: `policies` on a route-tree node. Node limits and budgets accumulate and are reserved per attempt through the node (node rule).

listen.description: host:port of the admin listener; default 127.0.0.1:8081.

servers.description: Resolvers as host:port; default: the system resolver.

tls.description: Extra CA for every egress without its own tls block.

header.description: x-forwarded-for | forwarded | any single-IP header name.

encryption_keys.description: Base64 of 32 bytes; the first encrypts.

stores.description: External secret stores, one per kind.

probe_scope.description: `cluster` counts `half_open_probes` across the cluster's nodes through leases in the shared counter store; `node` counts them per node.

Metadata.description: Free-form string → string map, ≤ 32 entries, keys ≤ 64, values ≤ 512.

EndpointToggle.description: An endpoint's settings: `enabled` (default true for endpoints).

allow_credentials.description: true with "*" is a config error.

ProviderAuthFields_api_key.description: The `auth` fields allowed with method `api_key`; every other method's fields are rejected.

ProviderAuthFields_aws_sigv4.description: The `auth` fields allowed with method `aws_sigv4`; every other method's fields are rejected.

ProviderAuthFields_gcp.description: The `auth` fields allowed with method `gcp`; every other method's fields are rejected.

ProviderAuthFields_azure_ad.description: The `auth` fields allowed with method `azure_ad`; every other method's fields are rejected.

ProviderAuthFields_none.description: The `auth` fields allowed with method `none`; every other method's fields are rejected.

DeniedUrlHost.description: A cloud-metadata host name or an always-denied IP literal as the URL's host.

NonCanonicalNumericHost.description: A host made only of digits and dots that is not a canonical dotted-quad IPv4 address (`127.1`, `1.2.3.4.5`, `2130706433`), or a first label in hex (`0x7f`), is rejected.

AlwaysDenyHeader.description: A header name on 's always-deny list (hop-by-hop, framing, credential and gateway-owned headers), compared case-insensitively.

Region.description: A provider region or location name.

Tier.description: A built-in tier (frontier, balanced, fast, specialized) or one declared in routing.tiers.

IpSetRef.description: A named IP set of auth.ip_sets.

KeyPolicy.description: Key lifetime and rotation policy at a tenancy level; the narrowest level that sets a field wins.

default_grace_period.description: Bounded by the 7d maximum grace of a rotation.

Smtp.description: Top-level `smtp`, dynamic: outgoing email for password resets, invitations, email alert channels and personal notifications.

tls.description: none is accepted only for a loopback host.

maintenance_windows.description: Informational windows; each one ends after it starts.

Catalog.description: The runtime catalog. `extend` lays its entries over the bundled catalog (an entry replaces a bundled entry of the same pattern); `replace` uses its entries alone.

version.description: The operator's label for this catalog.

models.description: Pattern → entry. A pattern is `<provider type>/<base model>` or `<base model>`; a trailing `*` matches by prefix (longest wins).

CatalogEntry.description: : capability values (the catalog layer of), the time-to-first-token hint and the catalog price of one pattern.

VaultStore.description: HashiCorp Vault: `${vault:<path>#<field>}` reads `GET <address>/v1/<path>` and takes `field` of a KV version 2 secret's `data.data`, else of `data`.

address.description: The Vault server, e.g. https://vault.internal:8200; operator egress.

jwt_file.description: method kubernetes: the service account token file, read at each login.

mount.description: The auth method's mount path; null = the method's name.

ttl.description: The longest a resolved value is used before it is fetched again.

AwsSecretsManagerStore.description: AWS Secrets Manager: `${aws-sm:<arn or name>[#<json-field>]}` is `GetSecretValue`; with a field, the secret string is a JSON object and the field's value is used.

region.description: The region of references that are not ARNs; an ARN names its own.

access_key_id.description: With secret_access_key; absent = the default credential chain.

assume_role.description: A role assumed with the base credentials.

sts_endpoint.description: Optional STS endpoint URL; default: the regional AWS STS endpoint.

ttl.description: The longest a resolved value is used before it is fetched again.

GcpSecretManagerStore.description:
Google Cloud Secret Manager: `${gcp-sm:projects/

/secrets/[/versions/]}` is the version's `:access` (default version `latest`).

service_account_json.description: Secret reference or literal JSON; absent = ADC.

ttl.description: The longest a resolved value is used before it is fetched again.

AzureKeyVaultStore.description: Azure Key Vault: `${azure-kv:<vault>/<name>[/<version>]}` reads the secret from https://<vault>.<vault_suffix>.

token_file.description: Workload identity: the federated token file; used without client_secret and managed_identity.

endpoint.description: A proxy or emulator base URL: requests go to <endpoint>/<vault>/secrets/… instead of https://<vault>.<vault_suffix>/secrets/….

ttl.description: The longest a resolved value is used before it is fetched again.
